messages:
incident-bot: ALERT INC-3377 — elevated 5xx rate observed on /v1/embeddings (us-west-2). Error signature: incompatible-runtime:variant_mismatch. Paging @oncall_ml and @sre_alex.

oncall_ml: ack. I see spike starting ~10:17 UTC. Lots of embed requests getting routed to a chat runtime and failing with schema errors. Pulling logs now.

sre_alex: on it. any known rollout around that time?

oncall_ml: quick query shows alias 'rwd-text-embed' resolves to variant 'rwd-chat-v2' for a pinned version id: v2026. Seems a pin/alias mapping ended up pointing to a chat variant.

oncall_ml: command I ran: 
```
curl -s "https://routing.internal/resolve?alias=rwd-text-embed&region=us-west-2" | jq '.variant, .pinned_version'
# -> "rwd-chat-v2"
# -> "v2026"
```

eng_rita: that v2026 was part of the multi-model rollout earlier today. We switched alias targets to enable unified aliasing; looks like the mapping was mis-specified for the embed alias.

prod_jamie: confirmed — pipeline job #468 applied alias map at 09:59 UTC that accidentally included chat variants in the alias set. We have a bad mapping rule.

cs_maya: any idea on customer impact? Which accounts affected?

oncall_ml: preliminary metric: ~120k requests over 30m with ~14% 5xx. Top errors: incompatible-runtime:expected-embedding. Affected customers: SearchCo (production), DocsAI (staging->prod bleed), and a handful of dev orgs. SearchCo reported elevated error rate and retries.

sre_alex: mitigation plan (short):
1) Temporarily block alias 'rwd-text-embed' from resolving to v2026 (set explicit override to embed-legacy).
2) Unpin v2026 from embed routes.
3) Rollback pipeline job #468 mapping to previous commit.
4) Monitor 5xx and latency for 30m.

oncall_ml: executing step 1 now — applying admin override to mapping service.

sre_alex: command to patch routing service: 
```
curl -X POST "https://routing.admin/api/overrides" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"alias":"rwd-text-embed","variant":"rwd-embed-legacy","expires_in":3600}' | jq .
```

oncall_ml: override applied. Confirmed resolution now returns 'rwd-embed-legacy'.

oncall_ml: rerun smoke: single request to embedding API returns 200, latency ~45ms.

sre_alex: rolling back pipeline mapping to commit abc123 (pre-rollout). Prod mapping reverted.

eng_rita: I'll open an immediate PR to add automated compatibility validation: alias pins must be checked for interface compatibility (embed vs chat) before applying.

prod_jamie: noted. We're pausing further alias/unified-mapping rollouts until validation is in place.

cs_maya: I'll message SearchCo and DocsAI with the short incident note and ETA for full postmortem.

incident-bot: INC-3377 created (sev P1). PagerDuty alert sent to oncall_ml, sre_alex, eng_rita.

oncall_ml: handing off to sre_alex for cleanup and post-incident monitoring. I'm available for context but will be offline in ~25m.

sre_alex: taking over. Current status: 5xx rate down from 14% -> 1.2% in last 10m; embedding success rate now >98%. Keeping override in place for 1h while we validate no edge cases.

eng_rita: RCA (initial): incorrect alias mapping in release job #468 allowed chat variant to be included in embed alias set. Missing validation and unit test in the mapping tool. Permanent fix: add compatibility checks + pipeline guardrail + canary on small percentage.

prod_jamie: action items I've logged:
- rollback mapping (done)
- pause mappings (done)
- add pipeline validation (assigned to eng-runtime)
- schedule postmortem (owner: eng-runtime)

cs_maya: customer comms: short message drafted, will send to affected contacts after SRE confirms stability.

oncall_ml: monitoring dashboards look stable. I recommend keeping override for 1 hour, then promoting a validated mapping.

sre_alex: agreed. assigning follow-ups: eng_rita for fix, prod_jamie for pipeline change, cs_maya for customer outreach. Postmortem owner: eng_rita.

eng_rita: I'll produce the postmortem with timeline and patch by EOD. We'll add tests and a safety check to routing service to prevent variant-type mismatches.

cs_maya: will follow up with SearchCo PM in next 10m and offer status page update.

incident-bot: INC-3377 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downgraded to P2.

sre_alex: closing thread for immediate action; leaving notes for postmortem. If any regression, re-open channel. :thumbsup:
